constellations.name: Orion
constellations.description: Orion is a prominent constellation recognized by its three aligned belt stars and its bright stars above and below the belt.

constellations.name: Ursa Major
constellations.description: Ursa Major is a prominent northern constellation. Its seven brightest stars form the familiar Big Dipper pattern.

constellations.name: Cassiopeia
constellations.description: Cassiopeia is a northern constellation recognizable by its distinctive W-shaped arrangement of bright stars.

constellations.name: Scorpius
constellations.description: Scorpius is a prominent constellation recognized by its curved body and long, curved tail.

constellations.name: Cygnus
constellations.description: Cygnus is a northern constellation whose bright stars form a distinctive cross or Northern Cross pattern.
